summary: The change adds atomic checks for both the destination and previous email index entries in saveUser and a deterministic barrier test showing that one concurrent assignment wins while the other leaves its user record unchanged.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts:714-716 reads the previous email index entry when the email changes.
src/auth_store.ts:739-743 deletes the previous index only after its atomic check and checks the destination index before setting it.
src/store_test.ts:327-374 uses a barrier on the destination email read and asserts exactly one save succeeds, the loser record remains unchanged, and the index points to the winner.
